facts.fact: In 2018, only 38% of colleges met new student enrollment targets by May 1, according to Inside Higher Ed (third-party survey data cited by StackAdapt).
facts.quote: In 2018, only 38% of colleges met new student enrollment targets by that date, and many now say that June 1st or July 1st are more significant dates.

facts.fact: Historically, May 1 has been the date by which admitted applicants reply to admissions officers, per the article.
facts.quote: Historically, May 1st has been the date by which admitted applicants reply to admissions officers

facts.fact: The article cites an estimated U.S. higher education market of $600 billion (third-party estimate from EdSurge).
facts.quote: an estimated higher education market of $600 billion

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends setting a goal to reach 80% of the high-school students in each state or province when planning audience size.
facts.quote: set a goal to hit 80% of them.

facts.fact: StackAdapt advises starting higher education marketing efforts a calendar year before the May 1 enrollment target.
The article was published on March 26, 2019.
